hooks.logic:
Let aiArg be the battle settings of the group of the enemy.
Let currentParamSuffixNo be the current form of the enemy.
Let v7 be false.
Count up "turnInCurrState".
Count up "turnCountForMeteo".
Let v8 be the count "turnInCurrState".
Let v9 be the count "turnCountForMeteo".
If condition flag v4 is up this frame or condition flag v5 is up this frame, then reset the count "turnInCurrState".
If condition flag v6 is up this frame, then set the register's 'hasMeteo' to true.
If currentParamSuffixNo is "1" or currentParamSuffixNo is "3" or currentParamSuffixNo is "5", then
  If the form for the enemy under the phases list is not currentParamSuffixNo, then
    Let v10 be call helper2 with (this state, list).
    Call helper3 with (this state, list, v10).
  Set v7 to true.
Otherwise
  If the form for the enemy under the phases list2 is not currentParamSuffixNo, then
    Let v11 be call helper2 with (this state, list2).
    Call helper3 with (this state, list2, v11).
  Set v7 to false.
If the enemy is ready to act, then
  If v8 is at least the numeric entry data at currentParamSuffixNo in aiArg, then
    If v7, then
      Let ability be the id of the move labelled v3 on the enemy.
      Let v12 be call helper2 with (this state, list2).
      Let paramSuffixNo be list2 at v12's 'paramSuffixNo'.
      The enemy uses ability with its cast time followed by [{abilityId: ability}, {abilityId: the built-in move DEFORM_MULTI, abilityOptions: {sequence: [[{deformTag: "deformation_01"}], [{builtin: "CHANGE_PARAM", paramSuffixNo: paramSuffixNo}]]}}].
    Otherwise
      Let ability2 be the id of the move labelled v2 on the enemy.
      Let v13 be call helper2 with (this state, list).
      Let paramSuffixNo2 be list at v13's 'paramSuffixNo'.
      The enemy uses ability2 with its cast time followed by [{abilityId: ability2}, {abilityId: the built-in move DEFORM_MULTI, abilityOptions: {sequence: [[{deformTag: "deformation_02"}], [{builtin: "CHANGE_PARAM", paramSuffixNo: paramSuffixNo2}]]}}].
  Otherwise, if not the register's 'hasMeteo' and v7 and v9 is at least the numeric entry "turn_count_to_meteo" in aiArg, then the enemy uses the move labelled v.
  Otherwise, the enemy picks and uses a smart-weighted move.
